title: Shared Giving Catalog
status: Registration due November 30, 2026; profiles due December 11, 2026
summary: An abbreviated profile application that places northern Arizona nonprofits in the Foundation's 2027 Shared Giving Catalog, which is distributed to more than 300 donor-advised fundholders.
description: The Shared Giving Catalog introduces Foundation fundholders to vetted nonprofits across the region. Each listed organization receives a one-page profile describing its work and a specific funding need. Fundholders recommend grants directly from their donor-advised funds.
Listing in the catalog is not a competitive grant. In 2026, 112 catalog organizations received $1.27 million in fundholder grants, with individual gifts ranging from $500 to $25,000.
The catalog is a good option for organizations that received a Community Impact Grant in 2026 and are not eligible to apply again until 2028.
impact_areas: Any Community Impact field of interest
Specific, clearly described funding needs such as equipment, a program expansion, or general operations
populations_served: Any population served by eligible northern Arizona nonprofits

geography.summary: Organizations must be located in or primarily serve residents of Coconino, Yavapai, Navajo, or Apache counties.

eligibility: Tax-exempt under Section 501(c)(3), a public agency, or a tribal program
Located in or primarily serving residents of Coconino, Yavapai, Navajo, or Apache counties
In operation for at least two years
Has filed its most recent IRS Form 990, 990-EZ, or 990-N

funding.type: Fundholder grants recommended from donor-advised funds
funding.summary: Organizations list a funding need of $1,000 to $15,000; fundholder gifts vary

how_to_apply.intro: The catalog profile is a short form that takes about two hours to complete.

steps.title: Register for the catalog
steps.text: Register your organization for the 2027 Shared Giving Catalog in the CPCF Grant Portal by 5:00 p.m. MST on November 30, 2026. Registration is a separate milestone from the profile submission deadline of December 11, 2026.

steps.title: Download the profile form
steps.text: Complete the Shared Giving Catalog Profile Form, including a 150-word organizational summary and one funding need.

steps.title: Gather a photo
steps.text: Select one high-resolution photo of your work and confirm you have permission from anyone pictured.

steps.title: Submit
steps.text: Upload the form and photo in the CPCF Grant Portal under "Shared Giving Catalog 2027" by 5:00 p.m. MST on December 11, 2026.

steps.title: Review and publication
steps.text: Foundation staff confirm eligibility and may suggest edits. The catalog is published to fundholders on February 1, 2027.

reporting.summary: Organizations that receive fundholder grants send a thank-you acknowledgment to the Foundation, which is forwarded to the fundholder. No formal grant report is required.
reporting.due: Within 30 days of receiving a fundholder grant
